You're not being paranoid—this sounds like a meaningful change worth taking seriously. Sudden or frequent forgetfulness, especially with basic information like the date or daily routines, can have many possible causes, ranging from stress and sleep issues to neurological or medical conditions that need evaluation. Trusting your instincts here is the right call.

The best thing you can do is gently encourage your friend to see a healthcare professional soon. You might say something like, "I've noticed you've been forgetting things lately, and I care about you—I think it's worth getting checked out." If he's resistant, see if another trusted friend or family member can help. If at any point he seems confused, disoriented, or unsafe, don't hesitate to seek immediate medical attention. You're being a good friend by paying attention.
